info.name: WEB4 OASIS API (all routes)
info.description: Every WEB4 OASIS API route (852 requests), generated from the ONODE WebAPI controllers by Scripts/generate_web4_full_postman.py. Set web4BaseUrl (production https://api.web4.oasisomniverse.one, dev https://dev.api.web4.oasisomniverse.one) and bearerToken (from POST /api/avatar/authenticate). Most request bodies are left as {}; see the controller or Swagger for each model. Do not run money, crypto or minting requests against production.
